consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance of the Grateful Dead on October 31, 1980, at Radio City Music Hall was strong, particularly highlighting the acoustic set and several standout songs. While there are mixed opinions about the sound quality, many reviewers appreciate the energy and musicianship displayed throughout the show.
